• Equity

• The best Sales and AI tools

• References.

• Offer.

We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

Front-End

This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

This is a remote position.

About Zazz

Zazz is a global IT services and technology company providing managed IT services, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, software engineering and technology consulting. Its managed services team supports clients through proactive monitoring, service desk support, infrastructure management and ongoing improvement. Zazz combines technical delivery with a focus on dependable services, clear accountability and long-term client relationships.

Role purpose

The Senior Service Desk and Project Engineer combines advanced third line support with project management and hands-on project engineering. You will own complex technical escalations, manage assigned IT projects from scope through to completion, and implement the solutions those projects deliver. Working with service delivery leadership, engineers, clients and suppliers, you will maintain reliable services while delivering controlled, well-documented improvements.

Service desk support remains a core responsibility. Project ownership and protected delivery time will be agreed with your manager, with competing priorities and capacity risks escalated early.

Key responsibilities

Third line service desk support
  • Own complex incidents and service requests escalated from L1 and L2, diagnosing issues across cloud services, identity, servers, networks, endpoints and integrations.
  • Lead technical investigation during major incidents, restore service safely and coordinate specialist or supplier support while retaining clear ownership and client updates.
  • Work to the applicable client SLAs and Zazz escalation procedures. Escalate technical blockers and service risks promptly, including when a credible route to resolution is unclear.
  • Investigate recurring faults through Problem Management, document root causes and workarounds, and deliver permanent remediation through approved changes.
  • Maintain accurate HaloPSA records, including impact, priority, diagnosis, actions, time, next steps and handovers. Validate the outcome before resolution and closure.
  • Coach L1 and L2 engineers, improve troubleshooting guidance and publish reusable knowledge to strengthen capability and reduce repeat escalations.

Project management and PMO responsibilities

Manage assigned projects and contribute to consistent project management office practices, using HaloPSA to maintain visible plans, ownership, costs and delivery status.

  • Define objectives, scope, deliverables, assumptions, exclusions and acceptance criteria with the client and internal stakeholders. Contribute technical estimates and delivery plans to statements of work.
  • Set up parent projects and child tasks in HaloPSA with named owners, realistic dates, milestones, dependencies, time budgets and completion criteria. Maintain schedules and assess the impact of changes.
  • Build project budgets covering engineering effort, hardware, software, licensing and supplier costs where applicable. Obtain approval, track actuals and forecast remaining effort and cost against the agreed baseline.
  • Plan resources with service delivery leadership and coordinate engineers, suppliers and client teams. Monitor critical dependencies and resolve scheduling conflicts before they delay delivery.
  • Maintain risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies and decisions. Escalate blockers, forecast overspend and missed milestones with clear recovery options and accountable owners.
  • Control scope changes through documented impact assessment and approval. Provide regular client updates and at least weekly internal reporting on progress, budget, milestones and decisions required.
  • Close projects with agreed acceptance, reconciled time and costs, lessons learnt and an operational handover. Contribute to project templates, portfolio reporting and improvements to delivery standards.

Hands on project engineering
  • Assess client environments and translate approved requirements into practical technical designs and implementation plans, seeking specialist review where needed.
  • Deliver client onboarding, migrations, infrastructure upgrades and service improvements across Microsoft 365, identity, cloud, networking, endpoint management, monitoring and backup environments.
  • Prepare and execute approved changes with risk assessments, prerequisites, implementation steps, testing, rollback plans and agreed maintenance windows. Obtain required technical and client approvals.
  • Configure and validate solutions, troubleshoot implementation issues, coordinate user acceptance testing and provide agreed support during go-live and stabilisation.
  • Produce configuration records, diagrams, operating procedures and support documentation in IT Glue and other approved systems. Transfer monitoring, access, support ownership and outstanding actions to the service desk.

Security and commercial responsibilities

Apply least privilege, secure credential handling and client security requirements throughout support and project work. Coordinate security incidents with the appropriate security specialists. Identify out-of-scope work and commercial opportunities for review, and obtain approval before committing expenditure or additional delivery. Record chargeable and non-chargeable time accurately against the correct ticket or project task.

Person specification

Essential experience and skills
  • Proven third line support or senior infrastructure engineering experience in an MSP or comparable environment supporting multiple clients, systems and business priorities.
  • Strong practical knowledge of Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Windows Server, identity and access management, and endpoint administration.
  • Advanced troubleshooting across DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, switching, routing, firewalls, VPNs and wireless networks, with an understanding of how infrastructure components and services interact.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, preferably Microsoft Azure, together with virtualisation, backup, recovery, monitoring and security controls.
  • Demonstrable delivery of IT projects, including personal responsibility for plans, budgets, milestones, dependencies, risks, stakeholder updates and client acceptance.
  • Practical IT service management knowledge covering Incident, Request, Problem and Change Management, SLA management and structured escalation.
  • Experience using PSA or ITSM, remote monitoring and management, and documentation platforms. Ability to maintain reliable ticket, project and time records.
  • Clear client communication, sound technical judgement and the ability to organise competing demands, mentor colleagues and explain risks and options to non-technical stakeholders.

Desirable experience and qualifications
  • Experience with HaloPSA, NinjaOne, Huntress, IT Glue, Keeper, Addigy or Druva, and with Google Workspace, Apple environments, AWS or Google Cloud.
  • PowerShell scripting, repeatable deployment methods and automation that improves support quality or reduces manual effort.
  • ITIL, Microsoft, cloud or networking qualifications, and PRINCE2, APM or PMP certification; relevant practical experience is equally valued.
  • Experience supporting regulated clients, security remediation and projects involving third-party suppliers or geographically distributed teams.

Measures of success ​

Performance will be reviewed against agreed service and project objectives, taking account of assigned scope, available capacity and dependencies. Measures will include:

  • Reliable technical resolution, timely escalation and clear communication against applicable client commitments.
  • Projects delivered to agreed scope, milestones, budget and acceptance criteria, with risks and changes raised early.
  • Accurate HaloPSA records, time reporting, documentation and effective transition into ongoing support.
  • Positive client feedback, stronger L1 and L2 capability, and measurable reductions in recurring issues or avoidable manual work.

Our client, SimpleTrials, is growing again!

Fully Remote | Life Sciences SaaS | $180K OTE Earning Potential

SimpleTrials is a growing provider of cloud-based Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) and electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) solutions, helping organizations simplify clinical trial operations, improve oversight, and maintain regulatory compliance.

Our solutions support pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, medical device manufacturers, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), academic research institutions, and nonprofit research organizations.

With customers operating across more than 60 countries, SimpleTrials combines powerful functionality, flexibility, and a customer-focused approach to help research organizations manage clinical trials more efficiently.

As we continue to expand our market presence, we are building a high-performing sales organization focused on accelerating growth, developing strategic customer relationships, and delivering measurable value to our clients.

Position Overview

SimpleTrials is seeking a motivated, results-oriented Account Executive (AE) to join our growing Business Development team.

This individual will be responsible for driving new customer acquisition, managing the full sales cycle, and developing relationships with organizations seeking modern, efficient, and cost-effective clinical trial management solutions.

The ideal candidate brings a successful track record in B2B SaaS or technology sales, strong consultative selling skills, and the ability to engage multiple stakeholders throughout complex purchasing processes.

Prior experience selling eClinical, clinical research technology, or Life Sciences software is preferred but not required. We welcome candidates from other B2B SaaS and technology sectors who demonstrate strong sales fundamentals, intellectual curiosity, technical aptitude, and a willingness to learn the clinical research industry.

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in shaping and scaling the sales organization while contributing directly to SimpleTrials' continued growth.

Key Responsibilities

New Business Development & Revenue Growth

  • Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, CRO, and academic research markets.
  • Manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through product demonstrations, proposal development, negotiations, and contract execution.
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities through outbound prospecting, inbound leads, referrals, and industry networking.
  • Achieve or exceed assigned sales targets and new customer acquisition goals.
  • Develop account strategies to engage prospective customers and identify opportunities within target markets.
  • Collaborate with Business Development Representatives (BDRs) and Marketing to maximize lead generation, qualification, and conversion.

Consultative Selling & Customer Engagement

  • Conduct discovery meetings to understand prospective customers' operational challenges, business objectives, existing technology environments, and purchasing requirements.
  • Present and demonstrate SimpleTrials solutions in a way that clearly connects product capabilities to customer needs and measurable business value.
  • Build relationships with key stakeholders, including Clinical Operations, Clinical Research, IT, Quality Assurance, Procurement, and executive leadership.
  • Navigate complex sales cycles involving multiple decisionmakers, technical evaluations, compliance reviews, and procurement processes.
  • Develop compelling value propositions that differentiate SimpleTrials from competing solutions.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to prospective customers throughout the evaluation and purchasing process.

Sales Execution & Pipeline Management

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date opportunity records, activity tracking, and sales forecasts within Salesforce CRM.
  • Develop and execute account plans and follow-up strategies to advance opportunities through the sales pipeline.
  • Prepare and deliver proposals, pricing recommendations, presentations, and responses to customer inquiries.
  • Coordinate internal resources to support product demonstrations, technical evaluations, security questionnaires, and RFP responses.
  • Manage contract negotiations while balancing customer requirements and company commercial objectives.
  • Provide reliable pipeline reporting, revenue projections, and deal updates to sales leadership.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Marketing to provide feedback on lead quality, campaign effectiveness, market trends, and customer engagement.
  • Collaborate with Product, Customer Success, and technical teams to address prospective customer requirements.
  • Facilitate smooth customer handoffs following contract execution to support onboarding and long-term customer satisfaction.
  • Share competitive intelligence, customer feedback, and market insights that help guide product positioning and go-to-market strategy.
  • Participate in industry conferences, trade shows, and networking events to build awareness and generate new business opportunities.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of successful B2B sales experience, preferably in SaaS, enterprise software, cloud technology, or another technology-driven industry.
  • Demonstrated experience managing the full sales cycle, including prospecting, discovery, presentations, negotiation, and closing.
  • Proven ability to achieve sales targets and consistently develop qualified pipeline.
  • Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to identify business challenges and communicate solution value.
  • Experience selling to multiple stakeholders and navigating complex organizational buying decisions.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
  • Experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or comparable systems.
  • Ability to quickly learn new software applications, industry terminology, and technical concepts.
  • Self-motivated, accountable, adaptable, and comfortable working in a growing organization.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications (Not Required)

  • Experience selling software or technology solutions to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, CRO, or other Life Sciences organizations.
  • Familiarity with eClinical technologies such as CTMS, eTMF, EDC or related clinical research software.
  • Understanding of clinical trial operations, research workflows, or regulated environments.
  • Experience selling software requiring technical evaluations, security reviews, or regulatory compliance assessments.
  • Familiarity with industry regulations and standards such as ICH-GCP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, or GxP.
  • Experience selling to mid-market or enterprise customers.
  • Experience with Salesforce CRM and structured sales methodologies such as MEDDICC, SPIN Selling, or Challenger Sales.

Important: Candidates do not need prior clinical research or eClinical industry experience to be successful in this role. We place significant value on proven sales ability, coachability, intellectual curiosity, and the motivation to become a knowledgeable advisor to our customers.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days – Learn & Integrate

  • Develop a working understanding of SimpleTrials, its CTMS and eTMF capabilities, target markets, and competitive positioning.
  • Learn the company's ideal customer profile, sales process, qualification standards, and value propositions.
  • Shadow discovery calls, product demonstrations, and customer discussions.
  • Become familiar with Salesforce workflows, sales materials, pricing structures, and proposal processes.

Days 31–60 – Build Pipeline & Engage Prospects

  • Begin independently managing discovery conversations and assigned sales opportunities.
  • Develop a qualified pipeline through outbound outreach, inbound lead engagement, and collaboration with BDRs.
  • Demonstrate the ability to communicate SimpleTrials' core value propositions and address common customer objections.
  • Lead prospect discussions and coordinate demonstrations with appropriate internal support.

Days 61–90 – Execute & Advance Opportunities

  • Independently manage active sales opportunities across the sales cycle.
  • Demonstrate consistent prospecting, pipeline management, and opportunity progression.
  • Develop accurate sales forecasts and maintain strong CRM discipline.
  • Progress qualified opportunities toward commercial decisions and contract execution.
  • Establish a performance and development plan aligned with assigned revenue targets.

What We're Looking For

Beyond experience and qualifications, we value individuals who demonstrate:

  • Ownership: Take accountability for results and proactively move opportunities forward.
  • Curiosity: Ask thoughtful questions, understand customer needs, and continuously learn.
  • Resilience: Stay motivated and resourceful throughout challenging sales cycles.
  • Collaboration: Work effectively with colleagues across functions to deliver the best customer experience.
  • Integrity: Build trust through transparency, professionalism, and a customer-first mindset.
  • Growth Mindset: Embrace feedback, improve continuously, and contribute to building a scalable sales organization.

Why Join SimpleTrials?

  • Meaningful impact: Help organizations conduct clinical research more efficiently and support the development of new therapies and medical technologies.
  • Growth opportunity: Join an expanding organization where your contributions directly influence company performance and market growth.
  • Career development: Build expertise in the growing eClinical technology market and develop professionally within an evolving sales organization.
  • Collaborative environment: Work closely with experienced leadership and cross-functional teams in a supportive, results-driven culture.
  • Product value: Represent validated, flexible CTMS and eTMF solutions designed to address real operational challenges for clinical research organizations.

Compensation & Benefits

SimpleTrials offers a competitive compensation package consisting of base salary and performance-based incentive compensation.

Additional compensation and benefits details will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Equal Opportunity

SimpleTrials is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and building an inclusive workplace. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, experience, performance, and business needs without regard to protected characteristics under applicable law.

Join SimpleTrials and help shape the future of clinical trial management technology.

Salary: $90,000+ / year

About Thomas  

Thomas helps organisations predict how people will perform, connect and grow at work.

For over 40 years, organisations around the world have used Thomas to make better people decisions. Today, we're building the next step: Predictive People Intelligence.

Our platform, CXI, brings together Behaviour, Personality, Aptitude, Emotional Intelligence and Connection, helping HR and business leaders make hiring, team and leadership decisions based on evidence rather than instinct.

We're growing across Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg, and we're looking for a Dutch and English-speaking Account Executive to help bring our people intelligence solutions to more organisations across Benelux.

The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to take real ownership of new business growth across Benelux, working with mid-sized and larger organisations to solve meaningful people challenges.

You'll manage the full sales cycle, from understanding customer needs and demonstrating value through to negotiation and closing. But the relationship doesn't end with the signature. You'll work alongside Customer Success to help the customers you win realise value and identify opportunities to grow.

You'll also be part of a collaborative sales pod, working closely with Business Development Associates and colleagues across the region to build pipeline, develop opportunities and strengthen our presence in Benelux.

We're looking for someone who enjoys winning new business, believes in consultative selling and is excited by the opportunity to help shape our growth in an important international market.

What you'll be doing

Win new business and develop customer relationships

  • Own the full sales cycle, from discovery and product demonstrations through to proposals, negotiation and closing.
  • Build relationships with senior HR, talent and business leaders, understanding their challenges and showing how Thomas can help.
  • Develop and execute a Benelux territory plan, prioritising organisations with the strongest fit for our solutions.
  • Work alongside Business Development Associates and regional colleagues to develop qualified opportunities, while proactively building your own pipeline.
  • Partner with Customer Success to support newly won customers and identify opportunities for further growth.

Drive commercial performance

  • Take ownership of your sales targets, managing a healthy pipeline and maintaining accurate, evidence-based forecasts in Salesforce.
  • Navigate complex buying processes across Benelux, including multiple decision-makers, procurement requirements and tenders.
  • Collaborate with Marketing on regional campaigns, events and initiatives that generate demand and strengthen our market presence.
  • Share customer insights, regional market trends and successful sales approaches to help strengthen our wider sales team.

Requirements

What we're looking for

We're looking for a commercially driven salesperson who knows how to build relationships, uncover customer needs and turn opportunities into successful partnerships.

You'll bring:

  • Fluency in Dutch and English, both written and spoken, with the confidence to manage customer conversations and negotiations in both languages.
  • A proven track record of winning new business and achieving sales targets in B2B SaaS, technology or digital solutions.
  • Experience managing the full sales cycle, using a consultative, insight-led approach to discovery, demonstrations and negotiation.
  • Experience selling into the Benelux market, or a strong understanding of how organisations in the region make purchasing decisions.
  • Confidence engaging senior stakeholders and navigating complex buying decisions.
  • Experience building your own pipeline, alongside working collaboratively with business development teams.
  • Strong commercial judgement, with experience managing opportunities, forecasts and territory plans using Salesforce or a similar CRM.
  • A proactive, self-motivated approach and the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across different countries.

It would be great if you also have:

  • French language skills, particularly for customers in Belgium.
  • Experience navigating corporate or public sector tender processes.
  • Knowledge of HR technology, talent assessment, psychometrics or people development.
  • Experience using modern sales technologies, including AI-powered tools.

You don't need to tick every box. If you have strong consultative B2B sales experience, meet our Dutch and English language requirements and are excited by what we're building, we'd encourage you to apply.

Why Thomas

  • Help shape an emerging category: Be part of our journey in Predictive People Intelligence, combining technology with decades of expertise in people science.
  • Play a key role in regional growth: Help develop our presence across Benelux, with ownership of your territory and the opportunity to influence how we grow.
  • Sell something meaningful: Help organisations make better decisions about their people, teams and leaders.
  • Work internationally: Collaborate with colleagues across Benelux and our wider Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success and Psychology teams.
  • Be part of a modern sales environment: Join a team investing in better ways of selling, from deal management and forecasting to AI-powered tools.
  • Flexible location: Based in Belgium or the Netherlands, with UK-based candidates also considered.

Thomas Assess – Our Talent Assessment Tool

At Thomas, we believe in the value of understanding people and bringing evidence into hiring decisions.

As part of our recruitment process, we use Thomas assessments to gain insight into role-relevant behaviours and strengths, alongside interviews and other selection evidence.

We're committed to an inclusive recruitment experience and welcome conversations about any adjustments you may need throughout the process.

Read to make an impact?

Join us and help more organisations across Benelux unlock the power of people intelligence.

About the Role

As the Senior Marketing Manager you will be responsible for leading Sibylline’s marketing function, overseeing the development and execution of an integrated marketing strategy that drives brand awareness, generates demand, supports business growth and strengthens the company’s market position. Reporting directly to the Director of Commercial Success, the role leads the in-house marketing team and ensures all marketing activities are aligned with Sibylline’s wider commercial objectives and strategic priorities.

This role encompasses the full breadth of B2B marketing, including brand and communications, demand generation, product marketing, content marketing, digital marketing and events. Working closely with senior leadership, the Client Success Team and subject matter experts across the business, you will translate Sibylline’s expertise and solutions into compelling value propositions, targeted campaigns and impactful marketing initiatives that engage existing clients, attract new prospects and support revenue growth.

As the leader of the marketing function, you will be responsible for setting strategic direction, managing budgets and resources, developing team capabilities and ensuring the effective delivery and measurement of marketing activities.

Essential Functions/Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership: Lead and manage a small in-house team, including a Marketing Associate and Sibylline Media’s Lead Editor, providing strategic direction, coaching and professional development
  • Marketing Strategy & Campaigns: Develop and execute integrated, multi-channel marketing campaigns that drive brand awareness, demand generation, lead acquisition and client engagement, aligned with Sibylline’s commercial objectives.
  • Performance & Analytics: Establish, monitor and report on marketing KPIs, evaluating campaign effectiveness, lead generation, pipeline contribution and ROI to inform ongoing optimisation.
  • Cross Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with the Client Success team, Product, Subject Matter Experts and other stakeholders to ensure marketing activities support business priorities and deliver consistent messaging that are aligned with our brand standards, culture, and strategic vision.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of the company's products and services and evolutions in the market.
  • Events & Engagement: Oversee the marketing and promotion of Sibylline’s own-brand and external events, working with the Client Success Team to maximise attendance, engagement and commercial opportunities.
  • On occasion, the Senior Marketing Manager will project manage cross-team collaboration on various facets of planning, execution, and follow-up activities.
  • On occasion, the individual must manage calls or projects outside of traditional business hours.
  • Marketing Operations & Budget Management: Manage marketing budgets, resources, systems and processes to ensure efficient delivery, effective prioritisation and continuous improvement.
  • CRM & Lead Attribution: Oversee marketing lead management and attribution within Microsoft Dynamics 365, ensuring accurate tracking of marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced leads, opportunities and revenue to measure marketing’s contribution to business growth.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to thrive in an electronic environment and utilise technology to deliver information.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and LinkedIn Marketing strategies.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team; adaptable to conquering new challenges in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent communication (both written and verbal, with English fluency) and strong interpersonal skills.
  • Exceptional leadership, team development, and project management skills.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Proven success in scaling B2B or B2C marketing efforts at a mid-sized company or startup.
  • Knowledge of the risk/security intelligence industry, and/or experience in an adjacent industry.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Communications, Marketing, English, or a similar field.
  • 8–12 years of progressive experience in marketing, including leadership roles in fast-paced environments.
  • Requires the ability to work flexible hours including evenings, weekends, and holidays as operational needs dictate.

About FinSet

We work with prop trading firms, forex and CFD brokers, iGaming operators, and other high-risk businesses, matching them with the right acquirers, PSPs, banking partners, and payment infrastructure.

But we’re not introducers who make an introduction and step away.

We’re hands-on operators who stay involved from the first conversation through onboarding, integration, compliance, corporate structuring, licensing, and ultimately live processing.

As part of our infrastructure, FinSet provides clients with access to our gateway and orchestration platform, which connects merchants to multiple payment providers through a centralized integration.

The Role

We are looking for a Technical Onboarding & Payments Support Specialist to own the technical support side of our client journey—from initial gateway integration and sandbox testing through launch and ongoing live processing.

You will be the primary technical point of contact for our merchants and will sit between the client’s technical team, FinSet, our gateway/orchestration technology provider, and the PSPs and acquirers connected to the merchant.

This is not a copy-and-paste support role.

We need someone who can understand a technical problem, investigate it, communicate clearly with developers, work through API documentation, and attempt to solve issues independently before escalating them to our technology partners.

When escalation is necessary, you will be responsible for communicating the issue clearly to the appropriate technical team, following it through to resolution, and translating the outcome back to the client.

The objective is simple: make integrations easier, launches smoother, and technical issues faster to resolve.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Technical Onboarding & Integration

Guide new clients through the technical integration with FinSet’s gateway and orchestration platform.

You’ll work directly with client developers to help them understand the API documentation, integration requirements, authentication, credentials, sandbox environment, payment flows, testing procedures, and the steps required to move into production.

You should be comfortable reading API documentation and explaining technical concepts to developers without simply forwarding documentation and expecting them to figure everything out themselves.

You’ll help troubleshoot integration issues, identify likely causes, and work with the client to resolve problems wherever possible.

When an issue requires intervention from our gateway/orchestrator technical team, you’ll gather the necessary information, escalate it properly, and manage communication until the issue is resolved.

Sandbox Testing & Going Live

Once the initial integration is complete, you’ll help merchants successfully move from sandbox testing into their live environment.

This includes:

  • Assisting clients with navigating the gateway/orchestration platform.

  • Helping configure and connect PSP/acquirer credentials as providers are onboarded.

  • Coordinating technical requirements between the merchant and the relevant PSPs.

  • Helping merchants perform test transactions and validating payment flows.

  • Troubleshooting failed tests and identifying whether issues originate with the merchant integration, gateway/orchestrator, PSP, or configuration.

  • Making sure the technical side of the setup is ready before the merchant begins live processing.

You’ll effectively act as the technical owner of the merchant’s journey from integration → testing → production.

Ongoing Payments Support

Your responsibility doesn’t end when the merchant goes live.

You will be the first point of contact for technical support in the communication channels we maintain with our clients.

When merchants experience technical issues, you’ll investigate first rather than immediately escalating.

Depending on the issue, you may need to coordinate with:

  • The merchant’s development or technical team.

  • FinSet’s internal team.

  • Our gateway/orchestrator technical team.

  • PSP or acquirer technical support teams.

You’ll be responsible for keeping communication organized and ensuring issues continue moving toward resolution rather than getting lost between different providers.

Issues may include transaction failures, API errors, configuration problems, credential issues, payment-method setup, routing questions, webhook/callback issues, PSP connectivity, or other payment-processing problems.

What We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate has previous experience in payment gateways, payment orchestration, PSPs, acquiring, or technical payments support.

Experience working directly for or with a payment gateway or orchestration platform would be particularly valuable.

You should:

  • Be comfortable reading and understanding API documentation.

  • Be able to explain API and integration requirements clearly to developers.

  • Understand the basics of REST APIs, API requests/responses, authentication, webhooks/callbacks, credentials, sandbox vs. production environments, and common HTTP/API errors.

  • Have a practical understanding of online payment flows and how merchants, gateways, orchestrators, PSPs, and acquirers interact.

  • Be able to troubleshoot methodically rather than immediately escalating every issue.

  • Know how to collect the right technical information—error messages, request/response details, transaction IDs, timestamps, logs, configuration details, etc.—before escalating an issue.

  • Communicate technical problems clearly and efficiently with external technical support teams.

  • Be comfortable working directly with client developers as well as less-technical client stakeholders.

  • Take ownership of issues and follow them through until they are resolved.

  • Be highly organized and able to manage several merchant integrations and support conversations simultaneously.

  • Communicate clearly and professionally in English.

Strong Advantages

We’d especially like to hear from candidates who have:

  • Worked for a payment gateway or payment orchestration platform.

  • Worked in technical support or technical onboarding for a PSP, acquirer, fintech, or payment company.

  • Supported merchants through API integrations.

  • Experience configuring PSPs or payment methods within gateways/orchestrators.

  • Experience troubleshooting live payment-processing issues.

  • Familiarity with payment routing, declines, webhooks, callbacks, transaction statuses, MID configuration, credentials, and payment-provider integrations.

  • Experience working with high-risk industries such as forex, CFDs, prop trading, iGaming, crypto, or similar verticals.

Coding experience is helpful but not required. We’re not hiring a software engineer.

We’re looking for someone technical enough to understand integrations, investigate issues intelligently, communicate effectively with developers, and know when and how to involve deeper technical resources.

What Success Looks Like

A successful person in this role becomes the technical person our clients trust when they need help.

Clients shouldn’t need to figure out which provider to contact or chase multiple technical teams themselves. You take ownership, investigate the problem, involve the right parties when necessary, and keep things moving.

Over time, you’ll develop a strong understanding of our gateway/orchestration infrastructure and the PSPs we work with, allowing you to resolve an increasing percentage of questions independently and escalate only when deeper technical intervention is genuinely required.

Your success will ultimately be measured by how smoothly merchants move from onboarding to integration, from integration to live processing, and how effectively technical issues are resolved once they’re processing.

Location & Availability

This is a fully remote position, and candidates can be based anywhere.

However, your regular working hours must align with Eastern European / Middle Eastern business hours, as you’ll need to be available during the hours when our team, clients, and partners are actively communicating.

The Director, Escalation Management is responsible for leading Escalation Management for Services, including a team of Escalation Engineers who serve as the technical escalation point for implementation and support issues before L3 Engineering. This role owns ITIL-aligned Problem Management and Release Management practices for Services, prioritizes escalations across customers and product lines, drives root cause analysis and corrective actions, and runs cross-functional defect review with Product and Engineering.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop Escalation Engineers, setting goals, priorities, and coverage across product lines and technology stacks.

  • Ensure implementation and support issues are triaged, reproduced, and fully documented before escalation to L3 Engineering.

  • Prioritize escalations across customers from a Services perspective, weighing customer impact, severity, business risk, and contractual commitments.

  • Own the ITIL Problem Management practice for Services, including problem identification, problem control, and error control, with problem records, known errors, and published workarounds.

  • Research, document, and publish root cause analysis (RCA) reports, and drive corrective and preventive actions to completion with Engineering, Product, and Platform teams.

  • Host a recurring Defect Review Board with each product line to agree defect priority, target fix versions, and owners, and publish outcomes to Services stakeholders.

  • Apply ITIL Release Management practices to track and communicate L3 ticket status and which product versions, patches, and hotfixes contain each fix.

  • Partner with Platform and Cloud Management to schedule and sequence patch and release upgrades to customer cloud environments to minimize customer impact.

  • Help customers and Services resources understand differences between end-of-life and new-stack products, and work with Product to identify and close functionality gaps.

  • Report on escalation volume, aging, fix status, upgrade schedules, and RCA outcomes, and lead communication for high-severity customer escalations.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience (required).

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise software support, escalation engineering, sustaining engineering, or technical services (required).

  • 5+ years leading technical teams (required).

  • Hands-on experience with ITIL Problem Management, including root cause analysis, known error management, and RCA reporting (required).

  • Working knowledge of ITIL Release Management, Deployment Management, and Change Enablement practices (required).

  • Experience coordinating software releases, patches, or upgrades in cloud or SaaS environments (required).

  • Experience running cross-functional defect triage or review forums with Product and Engineering (required).

  • Ability to prioritize competing needs across a large customer base and lead through influence (required).

  • Clear written and verbal communication with executives, customers, and technical staff (required).

  • Preferred: Familiarity with ITIL standards and formal RCA methods (for example, 5 Whys, Ishikawa, Kepner-Tregoe, or fault tree analysis).

  • Preferred: Experience supporting migrations from legacy or end-of-life products to new platforms.

  • Preferred: Familiarity with medical imaging, radiology, or clinical software, including on-premise and hosted deployments.

  • Preferred: Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP and multi-tenant SaaS operations.

  • Preferred: Proficiency with ITSM and issue tracking tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or Salesforce Service Cloud.

Quality Standards

  • Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.

  • Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.

  • Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.

  • Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.

  • Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.

  • Practices universal safety precautions.

  • Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.

  • Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.

  • Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.

  • Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

Travel

This position may require occasional travel.

Working Environment

Remote (United States).

Physical Demands

The employee must be able to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Искаш ли да бъдеш част от иновативен и динамичен екип?

Ако отговорът е "да", тогава тази позиция е точно за теб!

Ако си комуникативен, енергичен и мотивиран, присъедини се към нашия екип и помогни на нашите клиенти да получат най-доброто обслужване.

Като част от нашия екип Изходяща линия – продажби ще:

  • Провеждаш изходящи обаждания към клиенти с цел представяне на предлаганите банкови продукти

  • Консултираш клиентите относно предимствата на нашите продукти и услуги

  • Проучваш нуждите на клиентите, за да предложиш персонализирани решения

  • Насърчаваш клиентите да използват нашите дигитални услуги

  • Участваш в целеви кампании за продажба и подобряване на клиентската лоялност

  • Прилагаш проактивен подход за достигане на продажбените цели и увеличаване на удовлетвореността на клиентите

  • Работиш в тясно сътрудничество с останалите отдели за ефективно разрешаване на клиентските казуси

  • Подпомагаш екипа с идеи и предложения за подобряване на процесите и обслужването на клиентите

Какво ти е нужно, за да бъдеш успешен:

  • Отлични комуникационни умения и умение за работа с клиенти

  • Умение за работа под напрежение и решаване на проблеми

  • Отговорност, точност и внимание към детайлите

  • Добра компютърна грамотност

  • Владееш MS Office

  • Предишен опит в областта на клиентското обслужване ще се счита за предимство

Requirements

tbi e твоето място, ако искаш:

  • да получаваш фиксирана заплата и ежемесечни бонуси за постигнати резултати

  • да получаваш гарантиран бонус за първите 6 месеца, докато се обучаваш

  • да се възползваш от възможността да развиеш кариерата си

  • да се включиш във вълнуваща и иновативна работа

  • да получаваш признание за работата и отношението си

  • да придобиваш нови умения и интерактивни обучения

  • да станеш част от голям, приятелски настроен и подкрепящ се екип

  • да получиш допълнително здравно осигуряване

  • да се възползваш от страхотни намаления за карта за спорт и множество търговски обекти

  • да получаваш преференциални цени за нашите банкови продукти

За да разбереш повече за това какво ни прави различни, посети нашата кариерна страница.

Кои сме ние?
Искаш ли да се присъединиш към утвърдена банка със стартъп култура? Не, не се шегуваме!

От години сме една от най-печелившите банки и се разрастваме с бързи темпове. Ние сме банка с дългогодишна история на успех, която работи като стартъп и винаги търси нови възможности за развитие на бизнеса си. Как го правим?

Всичко е благодарение на нашия екип, който е съставен от смели, отдадени и сърцати хора. Ние не искаме просто да следваме отъпкания път - искаме да се превърнем в модерна и дигитална система от продукти, която обслужва всички финансови нужди на клиентите и партньорите ни. Нашите колеги обичат своята работа и 70% от тях биха препоръчали tbi като работодател на своите приятели и семейство. Нашите хора са ангажирани с предизвикателна и значима работа, вдъхновени са да развиват потенциала и кариерата си, насърчавани са да научават нови неща и да вземат решения. Това не са корпоративни приказки, това са думите на нашите колеги.

*Ние сме класирани на първо място сред банките и в топ 3 на най-добрите работодатели в България според класацията на WhereWeWorkза 2025 г.

Всички кандидатури ще бъдат разгледани при пълна конфиденциалност. С доброволното предоставяне на документи за кандидатстване за работа в „Ти Би Ай Банк” ЕАД, потвърждавате, че сте се запознали с „Информация във връзка с обработването на лични данни за кандидати за работа в „Ти Би Ай Банк” ЕАД“, която е публично достъпна на нашата кариерна страница.

      <title>Stripe: Abuse Research Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote from the US
</p>

<h2>Who we are</h2>
<h3>About Stripe</h3>
<p><span>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></p>
<h3>About the team</h3>
<p>Abuse Research Group (ARG) handles proactive threat hunting and adversary behavior analysis across Stripe products. Rather than reacting to alerts, the team maps end-to-end fraud and abuse paths, validates novel attack vectors, and identifies product conditions that enable fraud. Using agentic automated testing and simulation tools, ARG translates research into actionable threat advisories, strategic control recommendations, and regression scenarios to systematically eliminate vulnerabilities.</p>
<h2>What you’ll do</h2>
<p>As an Abuse Research Engineer in the Abuse Research Group, you will play a critical role in safeguarding Stripe’s financial ecosystem by proactively hunting for advanced threats, dissecting complex fraud vectors, and extracting actionable adversary intelligence. &nbsp;Rather than relying solely on reactive alerts, you will develop and execute hypothesis-driven threat hunting operations across internal telemetry and external sources to uncover fraudulent tools, tactics, and techniques (TTPs) before they impact Stripe’s platform. Central to this work is FT3 (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0), Stripe’s multi-layered taxonomy that decomposes monolithic fraud into structured kill chains. &nbsp;Collaborating cross-functionally with Fraud Ops, Strategy, Risk, Onboarding, and Security, you will integrate threat intelligence, build agentic simulation workflows, and systematically eliminate product vulnerabilities.</p>
<h3>Responsibilities</h3>
<ul>
<li>Proactive Threat Hunting &amp; Kill Chain Analysis: Formulate hypotheses and conduct iterative threat hunting operations across Stripe systems and external data.</li>
<li>FT3 Taxonomy: Apply and enrich the FT3 framework across empirical datasets and incidents, standardizing threat intelligence across kill chain phases and targeted API endpoints. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Threat Intelligence &amp; Signal Expansion: Partner with teams like Fraud Intelligence to integrate, curate, and automate threat feeds into engineering workflows. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Cross-Functional Advisories &amp; Strategic Controls: Translate raw research and retrospective findings into actionable threat advisories and control recommendations (policy, technical systems, support workflows, and detection mechanisms) for stakeholders across Fraud, Risk, Onboarding, and Security. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Agentic Testing &amp; Adversary Simulation: Utilize agentic automated testing frameworks to simulate adversary TTPs, validate whether deployed controls interrupt empirical kill chains, and generate regression scenarios to exercise controls. &nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2>
<p><span>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p>
<h3>Minimum requirements</h3>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience conducting threat intelligence, threat hunting, or technical incident response within cyber security, product abuse, or trust domains.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>5+ years of experience analyzing large, complex datasets using data analytics tools to identify anomalies, map behavioral trends, and solve complex fraud problems.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with demonstrated experience using code and scripting to automate workflows, build investigative tools, or query big data pipelines.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Hands-on experience in log analysis (e.g., application logs, API route telemetry, network security events), digital forensics, and cyber investigation methodologies.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Strong communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex technical research into clear, actionable recommendations and advisories for cross-functional partners.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Deep technical understanding of threat actor motivations, infrastructure, and TTPs specific to financial fraud (e.g., ATO, Card Testing, Credential Stuffing).&nbsp;</li>
<li>Familiarity with standardized taxonomies such as FT3 or MITRE ATT&amp;CK.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Proficiency with engineering, data processing, and analysis platforms such as Databricks, Trino, PySpark, Pandas, or Scikit-Learn.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Proven background utilizing Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIPs), tactical threat feeds, OSINT, and breach intelligence.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Demonstrated capability building or leveraging agentic LLM tools, automated testing systems, or control validation frameworks to model adversary behavior at scale.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Participation in industry conferences, webinars, or threat-sharing groups, alongside relevant professional certifications (e.g., GCTI, GCFA, OSCP).</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/stripe-abuse-research-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/stripe-abuse-research-engineer</a></p>
</description>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.)
</p>

<h3><strong>Commercial Data Scientist</strong></h3>
<p>Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.&nbsp;</p>
<p>At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.</p>
<p><br><em>This role can be filled in the Northeast (New York, NJ, Philadelphia, Boston), our San Francisco headquarters, OR other remote locations in the U.S.</em></p>
<p><strong>As a Commercial Data Scientist</strong>, you’ll work within cross-functional delivery teams alongside other analysts, engineers, and commercial stakeholders in discovering data insights to help improve healthcare.</p>
<p><strong>How you’ll make an impact:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Deliver novel and impactful insights for client organizations using machine learning and AI technologies.</li>
<li>Work closely with our Product, Platform Data, Insights &amp; Strategy, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses.</li>
<li>Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates and future projects.</li>
<li>Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform.</li>
<li>Embrace the challenge of a fast-paced environment to exceed client expectations</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team</strong></p>
<p><strong>As an organization we value diversity - </strong>in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Collaboration</strong>—The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.</li>
<li><strong>Passion for Data</strong>—You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights.</li>
<li><strong>Reliability</strong> – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success.</li>
<li><strong>Curiosity</strong> – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight.</li>
<li><strong>Respect</strong> – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>About you:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>At least <strong>4 years</strong> of professional experience as a Data Scientist or other related roles working with complex, high-volume, structured and unstructured datasets.</li>
<li>Prior experience in a data science consulting role at firms such as ZS, Trinity, IQVIA, BlueMatter, etc., where you thrived in a fast-paced environment</li>
<li>Advanced knowledge of statistical concepts — particularly exploratory data analysis, experimental design, and probability theory.</li>
<li>Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques</li>
<li>Proven ability to design, train, and evaluate large-scale production models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.</li>
<li>Advanced SQL proficiency — skilled at writing and optimizing complex queries across multiple tables and data relationships.</li>
<li>Advanced Python skills, including understanding of object-oriented programming, production-grade code design, and modern data science libraries.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with distributed data processing tools and concepts for scalable analysis and model training.</li>
<li>Excellent data visualization and storytelling abilities, with the capacity to translate technical insights into clear, compelling narratives for internal and client stakeholders.</li>
<li>Curious, fast learner with a demonstrated passion for data, continuous learning, and staying current with advances in machine learning research.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Fun</strong> <strong>Facts About the Client Intelligence team</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>We have access to one of the richest healthcare datasets in the world, with deep information on hundreds of thousands of clinicians and their connections.</li>
<li>Business decisions at Doximity are driven by our data, analyses, and insights.</li>
<li>The members of our team bring a diverse set of technical and cultural backgrounds.</li>
<li>We like to have fun - company outings, team lunches, and other social events!</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Compensation</strong></p>
<p>The anticipated total compensation for this role is $119,333 - $172,800 depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity.</p>
<p>Our total compensation package may include:</p>
<ul>
<li>Base salary</li>
<li>Equity (where applicable)</li>
<li>Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable)</li>
</ul>
<p>Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Benefits</strong></p>
<p>In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:</p>
<ul>
<li>Medical, dental, and vision insurance</li>
<li>401(k) with company match</li>
<li>Flexible paid time off and company holidays</li>
<li>Paid parental leave</li>
<li>Professional development and learning opportunities</li>
<li>Wellness and mental health resources</li>
<li>Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable)</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Why You'll Love Working Here</strong></p>
<p>At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Make a real impact.</strong> Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.</li>
<li><strong>Work with exceptional teammates.</strong> Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.</li>
<li><strong>Enjoy flexibility and trust.</strong> We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.</li>
<li><strong>Grow your career.</strong> Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.</li>
<li><strong>Bring your authentic self.</strong> We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Our Hiring Process &amp; AI Tools</strong></p>
<p>Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity</strong></p>
<p><em>Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.</em></p>
<p><em>If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation.</em></p>

      <title>Hex Technologies: Legal Ops</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> NYC or Remote (EST or CST)
</p>

<p><strong>About the role:</strong></p>
<p>Hex’s legal function has gone from zero to a fully operating system in under a year. Now we need someone to own and scale the operating layer so it holds as the company grows. <strong>This is a builder role.</strong></p>
<p>You’ll run contract operations end to end: CLM administration, workflow optimization, template and playbook maintenance, enablement and training for the revenue team, and first-pass review and redlining of standard agreements against our playbook. Beyond contracts, you’ll build structured intake for every legal workstream across the company, own the legal governance record (privacy registers, AI inventory, compliance calendars), manage outside counsel relationships, and own the legal tech stack. We sit at the nexus of data, AI, and collaboration, which means our legal operations have to be as thoughtful as our product.</p>
<p>We use AI tooling across legal operations, and you’ll work the same way: building agents and automations to move faster, not as a side project but as the default way things get done here. If you see a manual workflow and instinctively want to build it away, you’ll feel right at home.</p>
<p><strong>What you will do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Drive CLM adoption and enablement so the revenue team self-serves on standard deals</li>
<li>Own workflow optimization, templates, and playbooks as deal structures and products evolve</li>
<li>First-pass review and redlining of standard agreements; draft from templates as volume requires</li>
<li>Build and own structured intake for legal workstreams across the company</li>
<li>Build AI-powered workflows, agents, and automations that replace manual processes</li>
<li>Maintain the legal governance record: privacy registers, AI inventory, compliance calendars</li>
<li>Train cross-functional teams on self-service tools and escalation paths</li>
<li>Manage outside counsel relationships and the legal tech stack</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>About You:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>3-5+ years in legal operations, paralegal, or contract management, with at least 1-2 years in-house at a tech or SaaS company</li>
<li>You’ve implemented or rebuilt a CLM (Ironclad preferred), designed intake workflows, and stood up reporting someone relied on</li>
<li>Experience reviewing and redlining commercial agreements on both sell-side and buy-side paper</li>
<li>You build with AI and automation as a natural part of how you work. You’re comfortable across AI-assisted legal tools, LLMs, and automation platforms, and willing to experiment with new ones as they emerge. This isn’t a nice-to-have at Hex.</li>
<li>Comfortable operating with autonomy in a role with a lot of white space</li>
<li>Good judgment about what you can handle and what needs a lawyer</li>
<li>You care whether people actually use what you build</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Nice to have:</em></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience at a company navigating exponential growth</li>
<li>Experience with corporate governance (entity management, board materials, annual filings)</li>
<li>Has used Hex</li>
<li>Strong opinions about the best way to organize a Notion workspace</li>
</ul>
<p>We know job posts like this can feel like a checklist, and nobody checks every box. If you’ve built legal ops infrastructure, you’re excited about AI, and this role sounds like the kind of work you want to do, we’d love to hear from you.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr>
<p>In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary &amp; equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.</p>
<p>The salary range for this role is: $124,125 - $165,500.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness &amp; parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. Our Recruiting team will be able to provide more details during the interview process.</p>
<p>By submitting an application the candidate consents to the use of their personal information in accordance with the Hex Privacy policy:&nbsp;<span class="link-annotation-unknown-block-id-754370997"><a href="https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy">https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy</a></span>.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Hex Technologies uses AI-assisted tools as part of our application review process, including for resume screening and fraud detection. These tools help our <strong>team </strong>evaluate applications and verify applicant information. All AI-generated recommendations are reviewed by a member of our recruiting team before any hiring decision is made. No application is automatically rejected based solely on an AI tool's output.</p></div>

      <title>Lithic: Senior Risk Associate</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote 
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.</p>
<p>Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.</p>
<p>We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.&nbsp;</p></div><p>We are hiring a Senior Risk Associate to run Lithic's risk assessment function: the client risk assessment program, the third party risk management program, and the enterprise risk assessment. You will execute the assessments, own the operations that keep them on schedule and defensible, and continuously improve the rubrics, questionnaires, registers, and SOPs that govern them. You will also own program underwriting: the criteria, limit and reserve recommendations, and periodic reassessment that follow a client from diligence through scale.</p>
<p>This is an AI-forward role. Lithic is deploying agentic tooling across diligence and documentation workflows, and this role owns that build in the assessment domain: testing, tuning, and documenting the tooling so routine collection, review, and drafting are absorbed by automation, while you own the judgment calls, the exceptions, and the written product that goes to partner banks and examiners.</p>
<p>This role operates with limited guidance and owns its programs end to end. It is sized for ownership, orchestration, and judgment rather than queue/ticket processing.</p>
<p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Execute client risk assessments end to end: document collection, interviews, scoring against the weighted risk typologies, written assessment, tier determination, and pre-launch conditions.</li>
<li>Own program underwriting: apply and maintain underwriting criteria, recommend spend, transfer, and reserve limits, and reassess programs as volume, product mix, and financial condition change.</li>
<li>Run third party risk operations: vendor intake and tiering, due diligence and certification report review, control effectiveness ratings, the vendor risk register, annual reviews, and vendor issue and incident tracking.</li>
<li>Support the enterprise risk assessment and the risk register: maintain the assessment inventory and calendar, collect and test control evidence, apply the enterprise rating methodology consistently across sub-assessments, and prepare Enterprise Risk Committee materials.</li>
<li>Continuously improve the programs: refine rubrics, weights, questionnaires, and templates based on observed outcomes, and author and maintain the SOPs that make each assessment repeatable by someone other than you.</li>
<li>Test, deploy, and tune agentic tooling across the assessment workflows, including document review, questionnaire analysis, vendor due diligence, and drafting, and document the context that makes the output repeatable and defensible.</li>
<li>Define and report the KPIs and KRIs for the assessment programs, and surface concentration, trend, and thematic findings to leadership and oversight forums.</li>
<li>Serve as the evidence owner for partner bank, audit, and examiner requests touching client, third party, and enterprise risk assessment.</li>
<li>Mentor and cross-train teammates on assessment methodology, scoring discipline, and the tooling.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Hands-on experience conducting risk assessments in fintech, payments, or banking, across client or counterparty, third party or vendor, and enterprise or operational risk.</li>
<li>Working knowledge of underwriting fundamentals: financial statement review, liquidity and runway analysis, loss and exposure monitoring, and limit setting.</li>
<li>Fluency with rubric-based scoring methodologies and the discipline to apply them consistently and defend a rating.</li>
<li>A track record of owning discrete risk programs end to end with limited guidance, including authoring the SOPs and defining the metrics that govern them.</li>
<li>Ability to read control reports (ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS AOC) and translate findings into a residual risk position and a remediation ask.</li>
<li>Comfort working with AI-assisted or agentic tooling, including how to test, tune, document, and defend AI-assisted decisions to bank partners and regulators</li>
<li>Self-starter who can create structure where none exists and knows when to escalate and collaborate</li>
<li>Clear, concise writing under a compliance standard: assessments, memos, and committee materials that hold up in front of a partner bank or an examiner.</li>
</ul>
<p>The annual US salary range for this role is <span class="discussion-level-1 discussion-id-3d77e89a-8e74-80c6-adbd-001cb1e28a1e notion-enable-hover">$86,000 - $144,000,</span> plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>Benefits for Full-Time US Employees:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Unlimited PTO</li>
<li>12-weeks fully paid parental leave</li>
<li>4-Week Fully Paid Sabbatical (earned at your 5-year anniversary)</li>
<li>Work From Anywhere: work from anywhere in the world 4-weeks each year</li>
<li>3% cashback on card purchases with your complimentary <a href="http://Privacy.com">Privacy.com</a> employee account</li>
<li>Health, vision, and dental insurance; HSA Contribution Match</li>
<li>401(k) match</li>
<li>Voluntary Life Insurance and STD/LTD</li>
</ul>
<p>NYC-based employees work from our SoHo office three days a week. Tuesdays and Thursdays are our core days, and you'll choose a third day that works for your schedule and team needs.</p>
<p>In-office employees receive:&nbsp;</p>
<ul>
<li>Commuter benefit</li>
<li>Catered lunch every Tuesday and Thursday</li>
</ul></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/lithic-senior-risk-associate">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/lithic-senior-risk-associate</a></p>
</description>
